g.text: EleanorRank6Convo3 begins.
I don't know if you've noticed, but something bloody fantastic has happened.
Arthur's singing again. Thank the Gods.
Why did he stop?
I'm not exactly a fan, but if it makes him happy...
I'm glad. He's good at it.
Performance anxiety. Simple as that.
Thank you for putting that as delicately as you did.
Isn't he?
Hard to believe someone as brave as Arthur could be scared like that.
It matters to me that you care.
When I think of the effort it took to get him to stand up in front of a crowd of people and sing...
What's the crack in his armor?
Especially since there are reasons why he gave up singing, which you couldn't possibly have known about.
... the first time he really lost his nerve, I mean.
It’s the name. That’s the sodding problem.
Not enough moral support?
Too many tough crowds?
Solstice Carol Concert back in the eighties. Imagine our little man in short trousers doing the solo from How Bright The Dew Upon That Morn.
‘oh your name’s nightingale is it ha ha sing us a song then’
Hearing the same joke too often, more like.
That's quite a visual.
I don't know that one.
Different wankers, same line, all through our lives. Now Viktor’s doing it.
He took it so seriously. Weeks and weeks of practice and then, on the night, he bottled it. He hid in the wings and refused to go out.
Well. I’d sing it for you, but I’m not sure what sort of noise would come out if I tried.
+5 Chemistry
How did you convince him?
Bloody Techrot. I tried to sing Happy Birthday to Aoi and it sounded like a bullfrog caught in a paper shredder.
Honestly, I’m proud of Arthur for having the guts to sing at all.
I literally kicked his arse. Not proud of it. But it needed doing.
I’m sorry. It must be rough, not being able to sing any more.
Chat ends.
The thing is, he didn’t do all that practice for our parents’ sake or to make Mrs Henshaw happy.
Oh, it’s not much of a loss. I couldn’t sing anyway.
He was singing because he loved it. But when the spotlight was on him, he locked up.
The closest I came was screaming out lyrics from the Shag Cannons in my bedroom because I wanted to be in Mandy Jellicoe’s band because I fancied her.
Maybe he just needed to remember how much he loved to do it.
Cue my dad hammering on the door and threatening to wash my mouth out with carbolic if he heard any more of that filth.
Arthur's at his happiest when he can forget about Arthur. When he can lay the ghost of himself to rest and just BE.
(I don’t know if you have ‘punk’ where you come from but not being able to sing is more of a requirement than a dealbreaker.)
Beer helps.
We don't have punk, but we do have Skeg.
What happened to the band?
And it surely doesn't hurt that Velimir is acting like the dad Arthur would have chosen, if he could have picked one out of a catalogue.
Don’t you dare drop something like that into the chat and then not elaborate.
They didn’t even get to the ‘pity gig in the local pub’ stage.
I don't blame him.
I'd have thought Velimir and Minerva were a bit too much like your actual parents.
I demand you tell me what Skeg is.
Word got around that Mandy was planning to spit on the audience and that was that. Shame.
Arthur's been carting that teddy bear around for months. Now Velimir shows up. It's like destiny sensed a bear-shaped hole in Arthur's life...
yeah, well. Maybe the bickering makes him feel at home.
Because it sounds like something sold in little ziplock bags on a Ludston estate.
Who's afraid of a little spit?
Spit? Sounds like a Technocyte Coda's idea of a good night.
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
It’s like music except you make it by hitting pipes. And vents. And Corpus helmets. And anything else you can find to hit, really.
It’s just pointless noise. Only Ventkids like it.
+5 Chemistry
It was a different time. Back when punk was real punk.
... sorry. Not my business to speculate. I'm just happy that he's happy.
Weird what you can get homesick for, isn't it?
It’s a Ventkid thing.
Huh. 'Pointless noise'. I've heard that said before.
I bloody wasn't, I can tell you that much.
... I just thought 'I wish she could see me now'. I think she'd like this version of me.
Chat ends.
Chat ends.
+5 Chemistry
I don't think anything's so pointless that it can't be the soundtrack to someone's youth.
Gods, look at me, I've gone all soppy and nostalgic.
Hmm. Sounds like survivor music. Wouldn’t mind having a listen if you get the chance to record some for me.
I'd better stop. I'm getting sentimental.
+5 Chemistry
Best keep it off the Mall speakers, though.
Chat ends.
Better get back to it. Thanks for the ear.
Chat ends.
Chat ends.
